INSERT INTO collateral_matches (collateral_id, matched_collateral_id, match_score, match_type)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (collateral_id, matched_collateral_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                match_score = EXCLUDED.match_score,
                match_type = EXCLUDED.match_type,
                created_at = NOW()
